|.name: pipe
|.summary: Takes what the left command prints and feeds it into the right command.

&&.name: and then
&&.summary: Runs the right command only if the left one worked.

||.name: or else
||.summary: Runs the right command only if the left one failed.

;.name: then
;.summary: Runs the left command, then the right one, no matter what.

>.name: save to file
>.summary: Saves the output into a file, replacing what was in it.
>.warning: This erases the file's old contents.

>>.name: add to file
>>.summary: Adds the output to the end of a file.

<.name: read from file
<.summary: Feeds a file into the command as its input.
